events.title: 아스널 sign Swedish winger Anders Limpar from Italian side 크레모네세 for £1million.
올더숏 are saved from closure by a £200,000 rescue package put together by 19-year-old property developer Spencer Trethewy , which means that they will be able to start the new Football League season.
크리스털 팰리스 sign 윔블던 defender Eric Young for £850,000.
크리스털 팰리스 further strengthen their defence with a £400,000 move for 찰턴 애슬레틱 , their Selhurst Park tenants, for John Humphrey .
리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 share the Charity Shield after a 1–1 draw at Wembley.

올덤 애슬레틱 pay a club record £460,000 for 노팅엄 포리스트 striker David Currie . 리즈 유나이티드 are warned that they face expulsion from the Football League if measures aimed by the Football Association at curbing incidents of hooliganism involving the club's fans fail.
에버턴 sign midfielder Mike Milligan from 올덤 애슬레틱 for £1million.

리버풀 begin their defence of the First Division title with a 3–1 away win against recently promoted 셰필드 유나이티드 . 아스널 begin their challenge for a second league title in three seasons by beating 윔블던 3–0 at Plough Lane . 리즈 유나이티드 enjoy a fine First Division comeback with a 3–2 away win over 에버턴 . Key games on the opening day of the Second Division campaign include a 4–2 home win over 블랙번 로버스 for newly promoted 브리스틀 시티 and 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 's 5–2 home win over 포트 베일 . In the Fourth Division, 월솔 draw 2–2 with 토키 유나이티드 in their first game at the new Bescot Stadium .
맨체스터 유나이티드 and 리즈 유나이티드 meet for the first time since April 1982, and battle out a goalless draw at Elland Road in the First Division – a repeat of the last clash between the two sides.
The first month of the English league season ends with 아스널 and 리버풀 sharing the lead in the First Division after two games. The Second Division leaders are 올덤 애슬레틱.
